chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q2 — Long Essay: Visual/Contextual Analysis (6 points)
chunks.content: AP Art History Q2, Long Essay Visual/Contextual Analysis, 6 points, each earned independently. Task A (1): provide two accurate identifiers for the selected work. Task B (1): respond with an art-historically defensible claim/thesis. Task C (2): support the claim with at least two examples of relevant visual and/or contextual evidence. Task D (1): explain how the evidence supports the claim. Task E (1): corroborate or qualify the claim by explaining relevant connections. Points are independent — a response can earn evidence points without the claim point, etc.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 6/6
chunks.content: Q2 Visual/Contextual Analysis scored 6/6 — earns all tasks: two accurate identifiers, a defensible claim, at least two examples of relevant visual/contextual evidence, an explanation of how the evidence supports the claim, and a corroborating/qualifying connection. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 4/6
chunks.content: Q2 scored 4/6 — earns identifiers, a defensible claim, and the evidence points, but falls short on explaining how the evidence supports the claim and/or corroborating/qualifying it (the higher-order Tasks D/E). Typical mid-range: solid identification and evidence, weaker explanatory linkage.

chunks.subject: AP Art History
chunks.title: Q2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/6
chunks.content: Q2 scored 2/6 — earns only about two of the lower tasks (e.g. identifiers and/or a claim) without adequately supporting or explaining the evidence. Shows that identification and a bare claim alone cap the score low without developed visual/contextual support.
